title: Varginha witnesses in DC and FBI letter

tellings.quote: So when the after the Venia case when when those um individuals from Brazil came over, I was, you know, I was there with the with James Fox and and Leslie Leslie Keane and we were hearing from these individuals after the meeting.

plain: Witnesses from the Varginha case, a 1996 UFO incident in the Brazilian town of Varginha, came to Washington, and Congressman Eric Burlison says he heard from them in person after a meeting there. He tells Michels he was there with the filmmaker James Fox and the journalist Leslie Kean, both of whom have followed the case. The story also involves a letter to the FBI, but he gives no details about it in this telling. If what the witnesses told him is true, it would bring a foreign UFO case to the attention of Congress.
